source: web-panmer data/modxna_catalog_review.csv @ddda1bd: structures compared as SDF heavy-atom graphs (with and without stereo) from github.com/modxna/modxna web/lib_base. To be reported to the modXNA team.

DTT.text: named “Cytidine” in the modXNA catalogue, but the structure is thymine (5-methyluracil)

BSG.text: 8-amino-dA (an adenine derivative) listed under G; both amines carry dmf protecting groups

FYC.text: named 5-carboxy-dC, but the structure is identical to FWC (5-bromo-dC): it has Br and no carboxyl

T6A.text: same heavy-atom graph as TCA (no extra methyl); only the stereochemistry differs

M6U.text: structure identical to OAU (orotic acid), although the names imply one CH2 more

S2U.text: named 2′-thiouridine (a sugar position), but the base fragment is identical to SSU (2-thiouridine)

IGA.text: isoguanine, also listed under G as ISG

ISG.text: isoguanine, also listed under A as IGA

DHT.text: same base as M5D (5-methyl-dihydrouracil, listed under U); the stereochemistry differs

M5D.text: same base as DHT (5-methyl-dihydrothymine, listed under T); the stereochemistry differs

protected.text: synthesis phosphoramidite: carries protecting groups (N-benzoyl, N-acetyl, dmf, acetal, cyclic carbamate) that are removed on deprotection, absent from the final oligonucleotide
